new_page.description: Search Richmond penthouses for sale. 60 sold over the past twelve months at a median of $638,000, with prices by neighbourhood and building.

faq.q: How much does a penthouse cost in Richmond?
faq.a: The 60 penthouses that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $638,000, with the middle half between $534,250 and $731,250. All Richmond condos had a median of $598,000.

faq.q: How does a Richmond penthouse compare in price with other condos?
faq.a: A penthouse cost 7% more at the median, or $701 a square foot against $732 for all condos. Compare the floor area, the strata fee and the roof or terrace before you decide.

faq.q: How fast do Richmond penthouses sell?
faq.a: 30 days at a median, closing at 97.1% of list, with 2% over the list price.

faq.q: What counts as a penthouse in Richmond?
faq.a: 60 of the 1,218 Richmond condo sales carried Penthouse in the style field, most of them in Brighouse (15 sales). The listing agent enters that, so some top-floor homes are unmarked and a marked one is not always on the very top floor.

faq.q: Do Richmond penthouses have higher strata fees?
faq.a: The median strata fee was $542 a month for penthouses and $517 for all condos.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists penthouses for sale in Richmond: top-floor condos that the listing marks as a penthouse. It covers the City Centre towers, Brighouse, West Cambie, Steveston and Hamilton. Other condos, townhomes and houses are separate searches.

60 Richmond penthouses sold from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, out of 1,218 condo sales in the same area and months. The median penthouse sold for $638,000, 7% more than the $598,000 median for all condos, in 30 days at a median.

About buying a top-floor home in Richmond

Richmond’s 49 kilometres of dikes protect the city, and Richmond Fire-Rescue says pockets of liquefaction are possible in a significant earthquake. Before you offer, ask the strata about building insurance, the depreciation report and any past water damage.
Before you offer on a Richmond penthouse

items.t: Request the depreciation report and look at the roof line first, because a top-floor owner shares that bill before anyone else sees the effects.
Ask whether the building has had leaks through the roof or windows, and what deductible the strata’s insurance carries.
If the home comes with outdoor space on the roof, check the strata plan to see whether it is yours, limited common property, or common.
Stand in the unit on a hot afternoon. A top floor with a south or west exposure can run warm, and some stratas restrict air conditioners.

Compare the building’s fee with the $542 a month median for Richmond penthouses and $517 for all condos. A fee well above that deserves a look at what it covers. The median Richmond penthouse sold was built in 2005.
